title: Nourishing Smoky Croatian Pork Casserole
description: A hearty Croatian dish featuring charred and crumbly pork, dried chillies, and a sweet glaze, perfect for a sick day. This egg-free-friendly recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, brown sugar, and crushed dried chillies.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the pork until browned on all sides.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped potatoes, apple cider vinegar, and browned pork back to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven, baking for 2 hours or until the pork is tender and the potatoes are cooked through.
While the casserole is baking, prepare the glaze by whisking together 1/4 cup of apple cider vinegar and 2 tablespoons of brown sugar in a small bowl.
After 2 hours of baking, brush the glaze over the top of the casserole and return to the oven for an additional 10 minutes.
